resolution: Implemented the agreed editor lifecycle contract. Added schema-backed native Preferences for autosave enable/delay and hot-update Automatic/Ask/Off; unified explicit Save for active world/model documents; retained unsaved model work through in-process hot reload while never materializing it on disk; gated paint atlas creation behind a successful first model Save; autosaved only materialized models; added real Save/Discard/Cancel boundaries with proven working-copy rollback; split/debounced hot-state checkpoints; and made the authoring Eventbus a bounded process-session stream that is empty on cold start and retained only across V8 reload. ReleaseFast editor ship, focused TS suites, and all relevant Zig targets pass.
